assessment: This fundamental work advances our understanding of the retinotopic organization of early visual cortex in humans, and in particular, patterns of variability in the organization of V2 and V3 in normal populations. The evidence supporting the conclusions is compelling, with rigorous retinotopic analysis across a large publicly-available dataset. The work will be of broad interest to vision scientists, as well as those interested in inter-individual variability and neural fingerprinting using fMRI.
